title: Project Manager
description:
Job Summary
  
Service Manager will oversee end to end delivery of hybrid model mainframe application services using Cobol JCL DB2 Mainframe Utilities to ensure stable high quality business systems.
  
**AI developer:** Key Responsibilities
  
**Development:** Design fine\-tune and deploy machine learning and generative AI models.
  
**System Integration:** Connect AI models and LLMs to backend software and APIs.
  
**Performance Optimization:** Scale AI systems for speed accuracy and cost\-efficiency..
  
  

Responsibilities
  
Drive planning and execution of Artificial Intelligence projects by defining clear scope milestones and delivery plans that align with business objectives and client expectations.
  
Coordinate cross functional teams including data experts engineers and business stakeholders to ensure effective collaboration and timely resolution of project dependencies.
  
Monitor project progress using standardized tracking methods and dashboards to provide transparent updates on risks issues and status to stakeholders.
  
Manage project risks by identifying potential delivery obstacles early assessing impact and implementing mitigation actions that minimize disruption to timelines and quality.
  
Optimize resource utilization by aligning tasks with skills managing workload and working with managers to address capacity gaps across the project lifecycle.
  
Ensure project documentation such as plans status reports and closure reports is maintained with clear and accurate content that supports audits and future reuse.
  
Coordinate with clients in the Artificial Intelligence space to clarify requirements validate acceptance criteria and confirm that outcomes meet stated business goals.
  
Drive adherence to delivery governance processes by following organization standards for estimation change control financial tracking and quality checks.
  
Enable smooth hybrid working by scheduling regular virtual and in person ceremonies that support collaboration decision making and progress tracking.
  
Support integration of Artificial Intelligence solutions into existing enterprise systems by aligning technical activities testing schedules and rollout plans with client teams.
  
Align Artificial Intelligence project outcomes with enterprise strategies such as digital transformation customer experience and operational efficiency to create measurable value.
  
Collaborate with cards and payments stakeholders when applicable to ensure that Artificial Intelligence use cases respect regulatory expectations fraud prevention norms and transaction integrity.
  
Promote a culture of continuous improvement by capturing lessons learned from each Artificial Intelligence initiative and sharing practical recommendations across teams.
  
  

Qualifications
  
Require professional experience of at least five years in project management with a focus on technology or data intensive initiatives in complex environments.
  
Require hands on experience managing Artificial Intelligence projects such as machine learning solutions intelligent automation or advanced analytics implementations.
  
Require strong familiarity with project management methods that may include predictive and adaptive approaches and the ability to apply them pragmatically in hybrid work setups.
  
Require proven ability to gather requirements from diverse stakeholders translate needs into clear delivery plans and maintain traceability through the project lifecycle.
  
Require strong communication and facilitation skills to conduct meetings clarify expectations and manage conflicts in multicultural and distributed teams.
  
Prefer prior exposure to cards and payments processes such as authorization flows transaction processing and risk assessment within financial institutions.
  
Prefer understanding of data privacy compliance and security considerations relevant to Artificial Intelligence solutions in financial and customer centric domains.
  
Prefer familiarity with collaboration tools project tracking platforms and documentation practices that support transparent reporting in hybrid work environments.
  
Prefer relevant academic background such as engineering computer science information systems or business management with focus on technology projects.

title: Interior Project Coordinator
description:
**Role Summary**

We are looking for an experienced and detail\-oriented **Interior Projects Coordinator** to coordinate the design and execution of interior fit\-out projects for our retail pharmacy stores.

The role will be responsible for coordinating with architects, interior designers, contractors, vendors, landlords, and internal teams to ensure that store projects are executed as per approved designs, within timelines, budget, and required quality standards.

The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience in **retail/commercial interior projects**, strong site execution knowledge, and the ability to manage multiple projects and stakeholders simultaneously.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Design \& Planning

* Coordinate with architects, interior designers, and consultants for store layouts and design development.
* Review design drawings, layouts, material specifications, mood boards, and finish schedules.
* Ensure designs are practical and suitable for on\-ground execution.
* Coordinate design requirements based on different store sizes, locations, and site conditions.
* Support the incorporation of functional areas such as consultation rooms, baby care rooms, waiting areas, and other store requirements.

**Project Coordination \& Execution**

* Coordinate end\-to\-end interior fit\-out activities for new store openings, renovations, and store refreshes.
* Prepare and maintain project schedules, timelines, and execution trackers.
* Coordinate with internal teams and external agencies to ensure timely completion of project activities.
* Monitor project progress and highlight delays, risks, and dependencies to the reporting manager.
* Coordinate multiple store projects simultaneously and ensure projects remain on track for store opening.

**Site Coordination**

* Conduct regular site visits to monitor interior execution and progress.
* Ensure work is executed as per approved drawings, specifications, and quality standards.
* Coordinate with contractors and site teams to resolve technical and execution\-related issues.
* Identify and report deviations from approved designs and specifications.
* Monitor finishing quality, workmanship, and overall store readiness.
* Coordinate snag identification and closure before store handover.
* Ensure basic safety and site protocols are followed during execution.

**Vendor \& Contractor Coordination**

* Coordinate with contractors, fabricators, interior vendors, consultants, and suppliers.
* Follow up on quotations, material requirements, procurement, and deliveries.
* Ensure materials, fixtures, and other project requirements are delivered as per project timelines.
* Coordinate with vendors to resolve execution and delivery\-related issues.
* Maintain regular communication with vendors and contractors throughout the project.

**BOQ, Cost \& Documentation**

* Assist in preparing, reviewing, and verifying BOQs and project estimates.
* Review quantities, material specifications, and rates in coordination with the concerned teams.
* Track project costs against approved budgets and highlight variations.
* Coordinate invoice verification and supporting documentation for project\-related expenses.
* Maintain project drawings, BOQs, quotations, work orders, site reports, and other project documentation.

**Quality \& Handover**

* Conduct regular quality checks during project execution.
* Ensure consistency with HealthSy's store design and interior standards.
* Coordinate final inspections and ensure all identified snags are closed.
* Coordinate the final handover of completed stores to the Operations team.
* Maintain project completion records and photographs for future reference.

**Reporting \& Stakeholder Coordination**

* Prepare regular project status updates and execution reports.
* Maintain project trackers covering timelines, vendors, costs, site progress, and pending activities.
* Coordinate with Operations, Procurement, Finance, Business Development, and other internal teams as required.
* Escalate critical project issues and delays to the reporting manager with suitable solutions.

**Requirements \& Skills**

* Bachelor's degree/Diploma in **Civil Engineering, Interior Design, Architecture, or a related field**.
* **3–5 years of experience** in interior execution/project coordination.
* Experience in **retail, commercial, pharmacy, showroom, or similar fit\-out projects** will be preferred.
* Hands\-on experience coordinating interior projects from planning through execution and handover.
* Experience handling multiple projects/sites simultaneously.
* Good understanding of interior fit\-out, civil works, electrical works, carpentry, flooring, painting, ceiling, signage, and finishing works.
* Knowledge of **BOQ preparation, quantity verification, quotations, and cost tracking**.
* Experience coordinating contractors, vendors, consultants, and site teams.
* Good knowledge of project timelines, procurement coordination, and site execution.
* Proficiency in **AutoCAD, SketchUp, MS Excel**, and project tracking tools.
* Strong communication, coordination, negotiation, and problem\-solving skills.
* Good attention to detail and ability to follow up on multiple activities simultaneously.
* Willingness to **travel frequently to project sites** as required.

**Preferred Profile**

* Candidates with experience in **retail store rollouts, pharmacy stores, supermarkets, showrooms, or commercial fit\-outs** will be preferred.
* Candidates who have independently coordinated multiple store projects from **site handover to store opening** will have an advantage.
* Strong practical/site execution knowledge is preferred over purely design\-focused experience
* **Interested candidates can reach out to pravin.k@healthsy.in or contact: 8925828032**

Pay: ₹40,000\.00 \- ₹65,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
